- **G? [M] A walk left running: Stop offers to end it where it went quiet** (2026-11-27) · Honour · aligned if reshaped
  From: /investigate, the owner's ask (2026-11-27). Brief: docs/research/forgotten-stop.md.
  Calls: ask at a held Stop, as drawn ("Ask, as drawn (Recommended)"); only after 30 min of quiet ("30 minutes (Recommended)"); End it moves the walk's end back, later readings kept and read out, `SNAP_RULES` bumped, no migration ("Move the walk's end back (Recommended)"); no reminder while it runs ("No; ask only at Stop (Recommended)"). Decision 0272, amending 0048, 0220 and 0041.
  Mock-up: docs/mockups/forgotten-stop/ (`mockup.html` and its pictures, kept local: the canvas could not be published from the session), approved in person as drawn, "Ask, as drawn (Recommended)" (2026-11-27).
  Done when: on the web build at 390 x 844, a walk left running and opened 20 hours later, its Stop held: the walk screen asks whether to end it where it went quiet, and with End it the replay's card, Chronicle's row and the day say the walk's own time, its end mark sits where the walking stopped, and no dotted line runs to where the phone was the next day.
  Area: walk-screen, tabs, replay.
  Touches: VISION.md Never "All-day tracking" (0036), "Editing out the lows" and Always "The lows stay in" (0001: only the quiet tail is cut), Never "Nagging" (no reminder), Always "Moments and the trace are truth; streets, areas and summaries are recomputed" and "Restraint"; decisions 0048, 0220, 0041 (amended by 0272), 0071, 0157.
  The slice: 1. A walk's quiet point is the latest of its last walking on (the read trace leaving its spot), the end of its last ride, its last capture and its last Resume; found the same, within a minute, on a web-shaped tail (one long break, then standing fixes) and a phone-shaped one (a long stay of a fix a second). 2. A sit mid-walk followed by walking, a capture, a ride or a Resume is never a quiet end; a slow walk (`outAndBack`, `eastonSlow` fixtures) never reads as quiet. 3. On the walk screen, Stop held on a walk quiet 30 min or more shows the card as drawn, "This walk went quiet at <time of day>[ yesterday]." with "End it at <time>" (the one filled button) and "Keep it all"; quiet less than 30 min, Stop ends as today with no card. 4. The recording bar's held Stop asks the same, with the same words, above the bar. 5. End it writes the quiet time as the walk's end: the replay, its card, Chronicle's row, the day, the end mark, the areas and the streets read the walk up to it, and the dotted hop to the next day's spot is gone. 6. Keep it all is today's Stop exactly. 7. A finished walk quiet 30 min or more at its end has "End it where it went quiet" in its More (⋯) (the replay card and Chronicle's row), which asks with the same words and buttons ("End it at <time>", Cancel); after it the row is gone. 8. No reading is deleted: Share GPS log still holds the tail; `SNAP_RULES` is bumped so kept walks are read again. 9. Nothing ends or trims a walk without the walker's tap, nothing is notified, and the words say a time of day, never a count or a number of hours (`check:vision`). 10. The paused strip's Resume and Stop stay whole at 320 px beside a day-long time (today "Resu…").
  Precedent: Apple Watch's End Workout Reminder asks rather than ends (verified, support.apple.com); Strava's Crop, AllTrails' crop of a recording's end and Garmin Connect's Trim Activity trim the end by hand from a menu (unverified). It departs from all of them by offering the point it found at the Stop itself, for the owner's own words ("do you wanna trim this walk down"). docs/research/adjacent-apps.md, "End a recording left running; trim its end".
  Payoff: every forgotten walk; the card, the row and the year say the walk's own time, and the next day's spot (often home) stays out of the walk. Cost: M by criteria, about nine source files: a new core module for the quiet point, `readTrace` or its loaders and `tiles.ts`, `session.ts`, `unsaved/stopEnd`, `app/walk.tsx`, `RecordingBar.tsx`, `WalkActions.tsx`, a copy module; native unverified (both Stops' ask on a phone, the phone's shape of a quiet end). Reopens: walk-screen, tabs, replay.
  Instead: the More (⋯) row alone (criteria 1, 2, 5, 7, 8), with no ask at Stop.
